name: WARNING: Dunkin' Boston Kreme Donut (Heavy Custard, Chocolate & Frying Fats)
whyItWorks: Combines palm oil deep-frying fats, artificial vanilla Bavarian custard, and a heavy chocolate glaze. The massive bolus of sugar and processed oils triggers rapid gastric emptying, severe osmotic diarrhea, and nausea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid cream-filled and frosted donuts. Choose a plain glazed yeast donut or English muffin.
